limitations: Retained and extension cohorts use different documented label-construction methods.
Pool Recall depends on the reviewed candidate identities and is not source-wide Recall.
Pre-run corpus rule labels are exhaustive automatic applications of twenty rubrics, not 428,620 independent annotations.
Unknown facts are not negative labels. No unsupported occupancy, lease, furnishing or availability claims are verified.
The structured native requests do not exercise natural-language extraction, explanation or browser UAT.
The complex suite remains on main plus a local timeout patch; it is not the same build as the structured suite.
